description.value:
The Juggernaut archetype is a Berserker who has stopped trying to avoid damage at all, instead learning to absorb and redirect it. Where other Berserkers dance around the edges of a brawl, the Juggernaut wades to its center and stays there, becoming an immovable wall of muscle, durasteel plating, and unrelenting momentum that enemy fire simply cannot bring down fast enough.

Juggernauts gain the ability to shrug off conditions that would stagger a lesser warrior, convert incoming punishment into fuel for their rage, and physically bully their way through enemy lines — dragging the fight to wherever they happen to be standing.
